Stable desktop navigation; complete mobile account access.

Shared accessible controls and state components, extracted as reused.
Error normalization and precise journal clearing payloads.
Timezone-aware civil dates for affected UI.
Focused card flow and accessible swipe behavior.
Responsive task library, forms and history.
Editor, renderer, toolbar and document adapter.
Rich text and reliable save lifecycle.

criteria.label: All routes, Settings, Help and Logout are reachable by keyboard and phone.
No document-level horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440px; verify reflow and 200% zoom.
Reproduce and verify the reported zoom issue on the affected real Safari/browser/device; do not disable pinch zoom.
Measure actual text, input, button, selected and focus-state contrast in both themes.
Initial focus, trap, Escape, background inertness, scroll restore and focus return work.
Gesture threshold/cancel, vertical scrolling, duplicate prevention, failure restoration and button/keyboard alternatives work.
Every agreed formatting feature survives save/reload/read/edit; legacy entries remain readable.
A failed save cannot close the editor or report unsaved content as saved.
Clearing title, tags and dimensions persists correctly.
Libraries distinguish genuine-empty, filtered-empty, loading, error/retry, pending and success.
No fabricated scores or charts; date navigation works around midnight in Asia/Kolkata.
Reduced-motion mode preserves every task and outcome without spatial choreography.
Reserve asset dimensions; lazy-load editor and noncritical art; measure LCP, INP and layout shift.
Frontend build/lint, focused UI logic tests and existing backend tests pass.

questions.title: Which visual world should lead?
questions.subtitle: See the dark Tasks and light Tasks concepts in the visual review.

options.label: Spartan Standard
options.detail: Oxblood, smoked Aegean teal, ivory and controlled bronze; the lead proposal.

options.label: Aegean Passage
options.detail: Limestone and ink, indigo navigation, brighter coastal artwork.

options.label: Use both as matching light/dark themes
options.detail: Keep one component system; choose the default after trying both.

questions.title: How directly should the artwork show heroes and mythology?

options.label: Landscapes, artifacts and occasional distant human figures
options.detail: Historical atmosphere with room for your own story.

options.label: Visible heroic figures and sculpture
options.detail: More human presence, effort and Spartan character.

options.label: Explicit gods, creatures and mythic scenes
options.detail: A stronger fantasy interpretation of the Homeric world.

questions.title: Should approved screens be built from image compositions or directly in code?
questions.subtitle: This controls the later implementation workflow, not whether custom artwork is included.

options.label: Image composition first
options.detail: Approve detailed screen images, then implement against them; stronger visual control, slower.

options.label: Code first
options.detail: Build directly from the agreed system and review the live result; leaner and faster.

questions.title: Batch 3: What should releasing a swipe do?

options.label: Save Done/Skip once the threshold is crossed
options.detail: Fast daily flow; visible cues and buttons remain. No unsupported post-save Undo.

options.label: Reveal the action and require a tap
options.detail: Safer against accidental answers, with one extra step.

questions.title: Which phone and browser show the menu zoom issue?
questions.placeholder: For example: iPhone 15, Safari; happens after tapping Tasks or focusing Search.

questions.title: How should we handle formatted journal storage?
questions.subtitle: The current API stores one text string; rich text changes what that string contains.

options.label: Keep the UI-only boundary
options.detail: Use versioned Markdown after the round-trip gate. Accept that exact searches across formatting may miss matches.

options.label: Review a small explicit API extension first
options.detail: Add deliberate format and plain-text search handling before rich-text persistence ships.

questions.title: What feels right or wrong in the previews?
questions.placeholder: Texture strength, artwork, darkness, scroll treatment, or a reference you want us to study.
